reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, unit_cost_eur,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY unit_cost_eur DESC) AS cost_rank
FROM products
WHERE category_id = 16
alternatives:
SELECT p.product_id, p.unit_cost_eur,
       1 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.category_id = 16 AND p2.unit_cost_eur > p.unit_cost_eur) AS cost_rank
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id = 16

SELECT p.product_id, p.unit_cost_eur, COUNT(p2.product_id) + 1 AS cost_rank
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN products p2 ON p2.category_id = 16 AND p2.unit_cost_eur > p.unit_cost_eur
WHERE p.category_id = 16
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.unit_cost_eur

other_way.sql:

other_way.tradeoff: Counting the pricier Earbuds gives the same rank on any engine, but it reads the table again for every product.
